handle_non_streaming: handle a non-streaming A2A request to a Pydantic AI agent with a given api_base and request params
handle_streaming: handle a streaming A2A request to a Pydantic AI agent using fake streaming to convert non-streaming responses into chunks
send_non_streaming_request: send a non-streaming request to a Pydantic AI agent and return the A2A SendMessageResponse
send_and_get_raw_response: send a request to a Pydantic AI agent and return the raw task response without A2A transformation
fake_streaming_from_response: convert a non-streaming Pydantic AI response into fake streaming chunks with configurable chunk size and delay
